text: おとうと　と　かれし　３にんで　りょこうに　きたの！

structure.jp: おとうと　と　かれし
structure.en: my little brother and my boyfriend

structure.jp: りょこうに　きたの！

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: に before a going or coming verb shows what you came to do. りょこうに　きた = 'came for a trip'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a number of people says how many do it together. ３にんで = 'as a group of three'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement is a soft, often feminine way of telling someone how things are. きたの = 'we came, you see'.
